issue_context.title: Replace `NewChunkFromPoolWithCapacity` with `NewChunkWithCapacity` in parallel sort spill
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

When judging if a chunk is full, we compare chunk's row number with `requiredRows` in the `IsFull` function. However, Function `NewChunkFromPoolWithCapacity` not set `requiredRows` in the chunk. This makes chunk always be full when we call `IsFull` function and leads to some unexpected behaviour.

review_comments: Can we reset the requiredRows for chunk got from NewChunkFromPoolWithCapacity? @xzhangxian1008

> Can we reset the requiredRows for chunk got from NewChunkFromPoolWithCapacity? @xzhangxian1008

yes, I have reset it in this pr.
